metadata.description: Shareable Claude Code dev plugins — workflow, architecture, integrations

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: The architecture decisions of a repository as an OKF graph on the brain standard: architecture:setup makes or migrates the corpus, architecture:learn writes one ADR, architecture:ask answers from past decisions, and /architecture:check reviews a diff against them.

plugins.name: business-domain
plugins.description: The domain model of a repository as one OKF graph on the brain standard: bounded contexts, terms, aggregates, events, and relationships, with business-domain:setup, business-domain:learn, and business-domain:ask, and a hook that runs regen and both checks

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product discovery and roadmap planning in two OKF graphs on the brain standard: one page for each requirement and each work item, typed links, product:setup, product:learn, product:ask, and a script that assigns IDs, checks the graph, and finds requirement drift

plugins.name: system-design
plugins.description: The architecture of a repository as one OKF graph on the brain standard, with system-design:setup, system-design:learn, and system-design:ask. It replaces the system-design skill of the product plugin.

plugins.name: thinktank
plugins.description: Structured multi-agent strategic analysis and Socratic deliberation for optimal implementation decisions

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration toolkit — ACPX dispatch + adversarial refinement loops, layered on superpowers.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Bootstraps a repo-tailored PR review system (contract + per-concern lens skills) into any repo via /code-review:setup, executes it with a repo-agnostic reviewing-prs orchestrator plus lifecycle skills, guides engineers through a PR with the read-only /code-review:hitl walkthrough, and walks one PR chunk by chunk in a pane with /code-review:review-pane.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: The base of every brain: the brain standard, the generic OKF knowledge graph, the registry of graphs, the general check, and the generic skills knowledge:setup, knowledge:learn, knowledge:ask, and knowledge:forget. It was the wiki plugin.

plugins.name: prompt
plugins.description: Measures any prompt, skill, command, agent or plugin against the prompt engineering principles in its reference file, then shrinks it. Counts instructions rather than tokens, runs ten checks in code, cites a rule identifier per finding, and proves the revision moved the count.

plugins.name: status
plugins.description: A Nord status bar (below the prompt in a terminal, in a band above it in the desktop app): the model, the context, a prompt cache pill (cold, or warm with the time left and the hit percent), the 7-day limit (or, on a session with no usage limit, the cost of this month), the folder, the worktree and the git branch.

plugins.name: sofa
plugins.description: Software factory: a team of Claude Code background sessions that build a product from the PRD and roadmap of a repository.

plugins.name: grounded-synthesis
plugins.description: Audit a draft against its primary source files. Find the facts that a source holds and the draft does not, and write a gap report.

plugins.name: aiml
plugins.description: Help a software engineer build an AI or ML feature, from the choice of approach (LLM, classical ML or hybrid) through design, plan, simulation, code scaffold, training guidance, evaluation and MLOps.

plugins.name: competitive-intelligence
plugins.description: Map the competitors of a market, gather public facts about them, and analyze one competitor through six lenses. Writes a SWOT, recommendations, and a result file for business-case.

plugins.name: prose-authenticity
plugins.description: Find the signs that a machine wrote a text, and rewrite the text so that it reads as human writing. Tiered detectors, voice profiles, and a humanize loop with a fact check.

plugins.name: ux-hci-design
plugins.description: Guide a person through UX design with the Design Thinking phases: research, personas, journey maps, design concepts, wireframes, and evaluation, with built-in accessibility (WCAG 2.2) and AI interaction guidelines.

plugins.name: data-strategy
plugins.description: Assess the data strategy of a software company: business alignment, the data platform, and the data product portfolio. Write a strategy report, a platform ADR, and a data roadmap.

plugins.name: strategic-partnerships
plugins.description: Find, design and decide on partnerships in a software ecosystem. Runs six phases: readiness, partner candidates, deal structure, technical integration, revenue model, and a go or no-go recommendation.

plugins.name: corporate-development
plugins.description: Run an M&A pipeline on one target company: readiness, sourcing, assessment, operational and financial due diligence, integration plan, and a go or no-go recommendation.

plugins.name: jtbd-market-discovery
plugins.description: Find market opportunities with Jobs To Be Done and numbers. Ten phases lead from one job statement to ranked opportunities, customer segments and a validated price. Use discover, quick-validate and wtp-check.

plugins.name: pricing
plugins.description: Find the right price for an AI product. Classify a feature, compute its price from willingness to pay and cost, design Good, Better, and Best packages, and audit a price. Use price, audit, package, and value-metric.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Plan the go-to-market work of a product. Build the brand identity, the marketing plans, the sales playbooks, and the revenue funnel from the real abilities of the product. Check each claim against a five-tier truth scale.

plugins.name: product-finance
plugins.description: Run financial analysis for a product team: market size, feature ROI, AI cost and ROI, unit economics, financial health, an instrumentation plan, a services model, and a cost-coverage readout. Use discover, setup, feature-roi, ai-economics, unit-economics, health-check, instrumentation, services-model, and cost-coverage.

plugins.name: architecture-assess
plugins.description: Assess an existing software architecture, design a new one, review one decision, check agentic delivery readiness, and classify the cost of a new agentic feature. Saves each decision through the architecture plugin and each design page through the system-design plugin.

plugins.name: business-case
plugins.description: Coach a thin business case into one a funder can trust. Check it against a rubric, fill each gap, plan evidence runs of other plugins, work out the numbers from the figures you confirm, and have an independent review check the case. Use build.
